x-overlay-note: Corrections to openapi/claim-list.json, applied by tools/generate.mjs as an RFC 7386 merge patch.
The claim model is the stalest document in the set: eight fields on every live claim are
absent from it, and they are the operationally important ones. AwaitingActionExpireDate is a
deadline the merchant is judged against, Deliveries carries the return cargo tracking, and
Reports carries the photographs the customer attached.
Note the casing: this one model mixes both conventions on the wire. lineItemId and tags are
camelCase; MerchantSku, Reason, Reports, Deliveries and AwaitingActionExpireDate are Pascal.
They are recorded exactly as they arrive, because that is what has to be read.
